secondary_exception_reasons.V2-Q0121: No single federal primary statute governs state negligence elements nationwide.
secondary_exception_reasons.V2-Q0122: No single nationwide primary Good Samaritan statute exists; duties/immunity vary by jurisdiction.

items.loc: SAMHSA Stigma and Language page: person-first, non-stigmatizing language and treatment barriers associated with stigmatizing terminology.
FDA clozapine REMS-removal safety communication: REMS removed effective June 13, 2025 while severe neutropenia risk and ANC monitoring remain.
DailyMed Methotrexate Tablets labeling: rheumatoid-arthritis regimen is once weekly and folic/folinic acid reduces selected adverse reactions.
DailyMed Levothyroxine labeling: empty stomach 30-60 minutes before breakfast; separate absorption-interfering agents including calcium.
CDC U.S. MEC 2024: migraine with aura CHC category 4; smoking age >=35 and <15 cigarettes/day CHC category 3.
FDA iPLEDGE REMS — June 16, 2026 update; implementation delay to Nov 15, 2026; testing enforcement discretion.
items.fix: Option B, rationale, and locator corrected to reflect continuing iPLEDGE plus FDA enforcement discretion for certain pregnancy-testing requirements.

items.loc: DailyMed Tetracycline labeling: tooth-development warning includes last half of pregnancy; developing bone also affected.
DailyMed Omeprazole warnings: C. difficile-associated diarrhea and osteoporosis-related fracture with long-term/multiple-daily-dose PPI therapy.
DailyMed Felodipine ER grapefruit interaction: grapefruit juice increases felodipine exposure by more than twofold.
DailyMed Sertraline Serotonin Syndrome warning: agitation, diaphoresis, tremor and hyperreflexia are compatible findings.
DailyMed Digoxin labeling: hypokalemia increases susceptibility to toxicity, including at lower serum digoxin concentrations.
29 CFR 1910.1030(d): contaminated sharps disposal and recapping/removal restrictions.
CDC Clinical Safety hand hygiene, C. difficile section: ABHS preferred in most routine clinical situations if hands are not visibly soiled.
CDC TST guidance: read 48-72 hours after placement; measure induration, not erythema.
CDC Preventing HIV with PEP, Workplace Exposures: immediate evaluation; PEP as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours when indicated.
items.fix: Official CDC workplace-exposure locator and review date strengthened; clinical content retained.

items.loc: CDC CAUTI Summary: acute-care catheter insertion uses aseptic technique and sterile equipment including single-use lubricant.
OSHA Latex Allergy: minimize natural-rubber-latex exposure; use synthetic/non-latex alternatives; hypoallergenic does not mean latex-free.
OSHA Safe Patient Handling: assess mobility needs and use appropriate assistive devices and trained staff rather than manual lifting alone.
CDC clinically unstable suspected VHF PPE: enhanced PPE/trained donning-doffing, single-patient placement, dedicated equipment with vomiting/diarrhea or instability.
42 CFR 489.24(a),(c),(d): medical screening exam, no payment-based delay, stabilizing treatment or appropriate transfer.
items.fix: Generic CMS patient-rights page replaced by direct current eCFR 42 CFR 489.24 locator.

items.loc: Cornell LII Negligent Tort: general elements include duty, breach, causation and damages; standards vary by jurisdiction.
Cornell LII Good Samaritan Rule: voluntary undertaking carries reasonable-care duty; statutory protections/duties vary by jurisdiction.
OSHA Whistleblower FAQ: protection depends on protected activity/applicable law; reassignment can be an adverse action.
42 CFR 482.43: discharge-planning evaluation and implementation requirements for post-hospital services and self-care capacity.
AHRQ Just Culture/CUSP: human error, at-risk behavior and reckless behavior require different system/accountability responses.
